verdict.rationale: Smithery's archived docs described this exact capability. Connect was said to handle OAuth flows with Smithery-maintained OAuth apps, store tokens in encrypted write-only storage, and refresh tokens automatically before expiry. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says 'Smithery API, Connect, and Toolbox' stopped working on October 31, 2026, leaving only a non-proxied registry, so the product no longer delivers this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the platform run OAuth flows for downstream tools and vault the resulting credentials encrypted, with automatic token refresh
